description: This Kotlin source file defines the class LocalDataStore, which implements TaskDataSource to persist and retrieve Task objects using Android's SharedPreferences with JSON serialization. It provides methods to load and save lists of tasks asynchronously using coroutines, and includes helper functions for JSON conversion.

classes.name: LocalDataStore
classes.description: A class that handles persistence of Task objects using SharedPreferences, storing tasks as a JSON array.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of tasks by reading a JSON array from SharedPreferences and converting each JSON object to a Task.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a list of Task objects into SharedPreferences as a JSON array.

methods.name: Task.toJson
methods.description: Converts a Task object into a JSONObject for persistence.

methods.name: JSONObject.toTask
methods.description: Converts a JSONObject back into a Task object.
